policies.text: A candidate attains prerequisite eligibility for tier-1 distribution when maintaining technical distribution eligibility alongside an accredited quality management facility.
Full licensing under the tier-1 program is granted to candidates with prerequisite eligibility who demonstrate no regulatory compliance violations over a five-year period.
Clean energy supplier classification applies to power generation facilities producing an hourly output of at least 300 megawatts from renewable infrastructure.
Specialized service level tiering is granted to corporate clients completing a minimum of 20 breach-free deployments within a single year.
Commercial partners qualify for expedited contract renewal if they maintain a quarterly transaction volume exceeding $5 million.
Technical distribution eligibility is awarded to an enterprise that either commits an annual research budget of at least $10 million or holds 10 or more active international patents.
A vendor receives preferred supplier status when achieving a customer satisfaction rating above 95% across three regional hubs.
Commercial vendor risk approval requires a vendor to hold operational liability protection valued at $25 million or higher.
